subtopics.label: Coronary Artery Disease and Revascularization
subtopics.description: Research on coronary artery disease management including percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI), coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG), fractional flow reserve, graft patency, multivessel disease strategies, and outcomes of coronary revascularization procedures. Includes comparisons of surgical versus percutaneous approaches, conduit selection, and perioperative outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: PCI, CABG, and multivessel disease strategies with comparisons of surgical versus percutaneous revascularization outcomes.

subtopics.label: Cardiac Surgery Outcomes and Techniques
subtopics.description: Clinical research on outcomes of cardiac surgical procedures including aortic valve replacement, mitral valve repair/replacement, aortic root and arch surgery, thoracoabdominal aortic aneurysm repair, and perioperative management. Encompasses surgical technique comparisons, sex and racial disparities in surgical outcomes, and postoperative complications.
subtopics.short_description: Outcomes of valve repair, aortic surgery, and perioperative management, including sex and racial disparities in surgical results.

subtopics.label: Valvular Heart Disease and Transcatheter Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on valvular heart disease including transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR), surgical aortic valve replacement, mitral valve interventions, tricuspid valve disease, and structural heart procedures. Covers device outcomes, imaging guidance, antithrombotic management post-TAVR, and comparisons between transcatheter and surgical approaches.
subtopics.short_description: TAVR, surgical valve replacement, and structural heart procedures with device outcomes and antithrombotic management.

subtopics.label: Arrhythmias and Cardiac Electrophysiology
subtopics.description: Research on cardiac arrhythmias including atrial fibrillation, ventricular arrhythmias, supraventricular tachycardia, and conduction disorders. Encompasses catheter ablation, cardiac implantable electronic devices (CIEDs), leadless pacemakers, ICD programming, antiarrhythmic pharmacotherapy, and electrophysiology procedural outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Catheter ablation, implantable devices, and pharmacotherapy for atrial fibrillation, ventricular arrhythmias, and conduction disorders.

subtopics.label: Heart Failure Management and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Clinical and health services research on heart failure including pharmacological management, guideline-directed medical therapy, hospital readmissions, mechanical circulatory support, left ventricular assist devices, cardiogenic shock, and heart failure with preserved versus reduced ejection fraction. Includes studies on polypharmacy, medication adherence, and transitions of care.
subtopics.short_description: Guideline-directed therapy, mechanical circulatory support, and readmission reduction across HFpEF and HFrEF populations.

subtopics.label: Cardiac Imaging and Diagnostic Technologies
subtopics.description: Research on cardiac imaging modalities including echocardiography, cardiac MRI, cardiac CT, transesophageal echocardiography, nuclear imaging, and quantitative susceptibility mapping. Covers applications in structural heart disease assessment, strain analysis, right and left ventricular function quantification, and intraoperative guidance.
subtopics.short_description: Echocardiography, cardiac MRI, CT, and nuclear imaging for structural assessment, ventricular function, and intraoperative guidance.

subtopics.label: Stroke and Cerebrovascular Disease
subtopics.description: Clinical research on ischemic stroke, hemorrhagic stroke, transient ischemic attack, and cerebrovascular conditions including stroke mechanisms, risk factors, antiplatelet and anticoagulation therapy, atrial fibrillation-related stroke, cryptogenic stroke, and stroke outcomes. Encompasses epidemiology, disparities, and secondary prevention strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke mechanisms, anticoagulation strategies, AF-related stroke, and secondary prevention disparities.

subtopics.label: Hypertension Epidemiology and Management
subtopics.description: Research on hypertension including blood pressure control, antihypertensive therapy, hypertensive urgency and emergency, community-based interventions, and hypertension in special populations such as pregnancy, HIV, and low-income countries. Covers global hypertension epidemiology, social determinants, and novel therapeutic approaches including renal denervation.
subtopics.short_description: Blood pressure control, antihypertensive therapy, and community-based interventions across diverse and high-risk populations.

subtopics.label: Pulmonary Embolism and Venous Thromboembolism
subtopics.description: Research on pulmonary embolism and venous thromboembolism including catheter-directed thrombolysis, mechanical thrombectomy, anticoagulation strategies, risk stratification, and outcomes. Covers epidemiology of PE, clot-in-transit, chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension, and management of intermediate and high-risk PE.
subtopics.short_description: Anticoagulation, catheter-directed thrombolysis, and risk stratification for PE and chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension.

subtopics.label: Aortic and Peripheral Vascular Surgery
subtopics.description: Research on aortic aneurysm repair (open and endovascular), aortic dissection management, thoracic endovascular aortic repair (TEVAR), peripheral arterial disease revascularization, and vascular surgery outcomes. Includes sex disparities in vascular outcomes, device surveillance, and limb ischemia management.
subtopics.short_description: Open and endovascular aortic repair, aortic dissection, peripheral arterial revascularization, and vascular surgery outcomes.

subtopics.label: Heart Failure Home Care and Patient-Centered Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on home health care for heart failure patients including home health aide training, transitions of care, patient self-care, shared decision-making, and social determinants of health affecting heart failure outcomes. Covers readmission prevention, medication management, and community-based care models.
subtopics.short_description: Transitions of care, patient self-management, shared decision-making, and community-based models to reduce heart failure readmissions.

subtopics.label: Social Determinants of Health and Cardiovascular Disparities
subtopics.description: Research examining social determinants of health, racial and ethnic disparities, and socioeconomic factors in cardiovascular disease outcomes including heart failure, coronary heart disease, stroke, and hypertension. Covers healthcare fragmentation, access to care, and community-based interventions to reduce cardiovascular health disparities.
subtopics.short_description: Racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic disparities in cardiovascular outcomes, healthcare access, and community-based equity interventions.

subtopics.label: Basic Cardiovascular Biology and Cardiac Regeneration
subtopics.description: Fundamental research on cardiac biology including cardiomyocyte regeneration, cardiac development, zebrafish heart models, iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes, endothelial biology, sphingolipid signaling, and molecular mechanisms of cardiac disease. Encompasses epigenetics, transcription factors, mitochondrial function, and vascular biology.
subtopics.short_description: Cardiomyocyte regeneration, iPSC models, endothelial biology, and molecular mechanisms of cardiac development and disease.

subtopics.label: Cardio-Oncology and Cancer-Related Cardiovascular Disease
subtopics.description: Research on cardiovascular complications of cancer and cancer therapy including chemotherapy-induced cardiotoxicity, cancer-associated thromboembolism, cardiac tumors, radiation-induced cardiovascular disease, and cardiovascular management in cancer patients. Covers immune checkpoint inhibitor myocarditis, doxorubicin cardiotoxicity, and cancer-related stroke.
subtopics.short_description: Chemotherapy cardiotoxicity, checkpoint inhibitor myocarditis, radiation-induced cardiovascular disease, and cancer-associated thromboembolism.

subtopics.label: Takotsubo Syndrome: Epidemiology, Outcomes, and Management
subtopics.description: Research on Takotsubo (stress) cardiomyopathy covering clinical characteristics, ECG and imaging features, comparison with STEMI, recurrence, beta-blocker therapy, and short- and long-term outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical features, imaging, recurrence risk, and short- and long-term outcomes of stress-induced Takotsubo cardiomyopathy.

subtopics.label: Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting: Techniques, Grafts, and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies examining CABG surgical techniques including arterial and venous grafting strategies, graft patency, operative outcomes by sex and comorbidity, and quality-of-life measures after bypass surgery.
subtopics.short_description: Arterial and venous grafting strategies, graft patency, operative outcomes by sex and comorbidity, and post-bypass quality of life.

subtopics.label: STEMI Management, Primary PCI, and Myocardial Infarction Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on ST-elevation myocardial infarction management including primary PCI timing, infarct size, microvascular obstruction, supersaturated oxygen therapy, antiplatelet strategies, and temporal trends in MI outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Primary PCI timing, infarct size, microvascular obstruction, antiplatelet strategies, and temporal trends in myocardial infarction outcomes.

subtopics.label: Heart Transplantation Outcomes and Complications
subtopics.description: Studies on heart transplantation covering graft dysfunction, allograft vasculopathy, rejection, donor factors, recipient characteristics, post-transplant weight gain, and long-term survival outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Graft dysfunction, allograft vasculopathy, rejection, donor and recipient factors, and long-term survival after heart transplantation.

subtopics.label: HIV and Cardiovascular Disease Risk and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research examining cardiovascular complications in people living with HIV, including hypertension, diastolic dysfunction, arterial stiffness, lipid abnormalities, autonomic dysfunction, and the impact of antiretroviral therapy on cardiovascular risk.
subtopics.short_description: Hypertension, arterial stiffness, diastolic dysfunction, and antiretroviral therapy effects on cardiovascular risk in people living with HIV.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 and Cardiovascular Complications
subtopics.description: Studies on cardiovascular manifestations of COVID-19 including myocardial injury, troponin elevation, arrhythmias, thrombotic events, right ventricular dysfunction, myocarditis, and outcomes in hospitalized patients.
subtopics.short_description: Myocardial injury, arrhythmias, thrombotic events, myocarditis, and right ventricular dysfunction in hospitalized COVID-19 patients.

subtopics.label: Long COVID and Post-Acute Sequelae of SARS-CoV-2
subtopics.description: Research characterizing post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 infection (PASC/Long COVID), including risk factor identification, subphenotyping, environmental determinants, and burden of respiratory and cardiovascular conditions using EHR-based cohort studies.
subtopics.short_description: Risk factors, subphenotypes, and cardiovascular and respiratory burden of PASC using large EHR-based cohort studies.

subtopics.label: Chronic Kidney Disease and Cardiorenal Interactions
subtopics.description: Studies on the intersection of chronic kidney disease and cardiovascular disease, including iron status, FGF23, serotonin, klotho, pulmonary hypertension screening, cardiac biomarkers, and outcomes in CKD patients.
subtopics.short_description: FGF23, klotho, iron status, and cardiac biomarkers linking chronic kidney disease to cardiovascular outcomes and pulmonary hypertension.

subtopics.label: Diabetes, Metabolic Syndrome, and Cardiovascular Risk
subtopics.description: Research on the cardiovascular implications of diabetes and metabolic syndrome, including glycemic control, prediabetes subclassification, autonomic neuropathy, lipid dysregulation, obesity, and risk factor management in diabetic patients.
subtopics.short_description: Glycemic control, autonomic neuropathy, lipid dysregulation, and obesity as cardiovascular risk factors in diabetic patients.

subtopics.label: Stroke Risk Factors, Secondary Prevention, and Smoking Cessation
subtopics.description: Studies on modifiable risk factors for stroke including smoking cessation interventions, antiplatelet therapy, anticoagulation, and secondary prevention strategies after ischemic stroke and TIA.
subtopics.short_description: Smoking cessation, antiplatelet therapy, anticoagulation, and secondary prevention strategies after ischemic stroke and TIA.

subtopics.label: Hypothalamic Neurobiology and Neurogenic Hypertension
subtopics.description: Basic science research on the role of hypothalamic paraventricular nucleus signaling, including angiotensin II, TNF-alpha, estrogen receptors, and NMDA/AMPA glutamate receptors in the neurogenic regulation of blood pressure.
subtopics.short_description: Paraventricular nucleus signaling via angiotensin II, TNF-alpha, and glutamate receptors in the neurogenic regulation of blood pressure.

subtopics.label: Rheumatoid Arthritis and Cardiovascular Disease
subtopics.description: Research on cardiovascular risk in patients with rheumatoid arthritis and inflammatory arthritis, including hyperlipidemia screening, CVD risk prediction, dementia risk, and behavioral interventions to reduce cardiovascular risk.
subtopics.short_description: CVD risk prediction, hyperlipidemia screening, and behavioral interventions for cardiovascular risk reduction in inflammatory arthritis.

subtopics.label: Sex and Gender Disparities in Cardiovascular Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies examining sex-based differences in cardiovascular disease presentation, treatment, and outcomes including STEMI revascularization, cardiac surgery, cardiogenic shock, cardiac arrest readmission, and patient-physician concordance.
subtopics.display_name: Sex & Gender Disparities in Cardiovascular Care
subtopics.short_description: Sex-based differences in cardiovascular presentation, treatment access, and outcomes across STEMI, cardiac surgery, and cardiogenic shock.

subtopics.label: Mitochondrial Biology, Ischemia-Reperfusion, and Cardioprotection
subtopics.description: Basic and translational research on mitochondrial function in cardiac ischemia-reperfusion injury, including reactive oxygen species production, ischemic preconditioning, complex I biology, and metabolic remodeling in cardiomyopathy models.
subtopics.short_description: Mitochondrial ROS, ischemic preconditioning, complex I biology, and metabolic remodeling in cardiac ischemia-reperfusion injury.

subtopics.label: Stroke and Cerebrovascular Disease
subtopics.description: Research on ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke including mechanisms, risk factors, diagnosis, treatment (thrombolysis, thrombectomy, anticoagulation), outcomes, disparities, and secondary prevention. Covers atrial fibrillation, cervical artery dissection, subarachnoid hemorrhage, cerebral amyloid angiopathy, and cerebrovascular imaging biomarkers.
subtopics.short_description: Mechanisms, treatment, outcomes, and prevention of ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke and cerebrovascular conditions.

subtopics.label: Epilepsy and Seizure Disorders
subtopics.description: Research on epilepsy diagnosis, seizure mechanisms, treatment (antiseizure medications, vagal nerve stimulation, surgery), EEG monitoring, infantile spasms, status epilepticus, and epilepsy care systems. Includes pediatric epilepsy, rare epilepsies, glucose transporter deficiency, and seizure detection technologies.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis, seizure mechanisms, pharmacological and surgical treatment, and monitoring of epilepsy across the lifespan.

subtopics.label: Brain Injury and Neurorehabilitation
subtopics.description: Research on traumatic brain injury (TBI), acquired brain injury, disorders of consciousness, and neurorehabilitation including cognitive recovery, functional outcomes, assistive technology, and neuromodulation for recovery. Covers pediatric TBI, cognitive-motor dissociation, deep brain stimulation for TBI, and rehabilitation interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Traumatic and acquired brain injury, disorders of consciousness, and cognitive-functional recovery through rehabilitation.

subtopics.label: Neuroimaging Methods and Brain MRI
subtopics.description: Research on advanced neuroimaging techniques including quantitative susceptibility mapping (QSM), oxygen extraction fraction mapping, arterial spin labeling, fMRI methods, diffusion imaging, and brain PET. Covers technical development, validation, and clinical application of MRI-based biomarkers for neurological and psychiatric conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Quantitative MRI, fMRI, diffusion, and PET techniques for biomarker development and clinical neurological applications.

subtopics.label: Corneal Confocal Microscopy and Peripheral Neuropathy
subtopics.description: Research using corneal confocal microscopy (CCM) as a non-invasive biomarker for peripheral neuropathy, neurodegeneration, and systemic diseases including diabetic neuropathy, multiple sclerosis, Parkinson's disease, and stroke. Covers corneal nerve fiber loss quantification, Langerhans cells, and CCM as a surrogate marker for central and peripheral nervous system pathology.
subtopics.short_description: Non-invasive corneal nerve imaging as a biomarker for peripheral neuropathy and systemic neurological disease.

subtopics.label: Multiple Sclerosis: Imaging, Biomarkers, and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on multiple sclerosis including MRI-based lesion characterization (paramagnetic rim lesions, QSM), functional and structural connectivity, corneal nerve biomarkers, disease-modifying therapies (natalizumab), and clinical outcomes. Covers demyelination mechanisms, white matter pathology, and treatment effectiveness across diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: MRI lesion characterization, corneal biomarkers, disease-modifying therapies, and clinical outcomes in multiple sclerosis.

subtopics.label: Synaptic Biology and Ion Channel Physiology
subtopics.description: Research on molecular mechanisms of synaptic transmission, vesicle release, and ion channel function including SNARE proteins, Munc13/Munc18, complexin, alpha-synuclein, metabotropic glutamate receptors, potassium channels (BK, K2P, HCN), sodium channels, and glutamate transporters. Covers structural biology, electrophysiology, and pharmacology of synaptic and membrane proteins.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms of synaptic transmission, vesicle release, and ion channel structure, function, and pharmacology.

subtopics.label: Neuroinflammation, Microglia, and Neuroimmunology
subtopics.description: Research on neuroinflammation mechanisms including microglial function, tau-driven neuroinflammation, blood-brain barrier dysfunction, neuroimmune interactions, and inflammatory pathways in neurological diseases. Covers microglial NF-κB signaling, cGAS-IFN pathways, CD36, border-associated macrophages, and immune cell trafficking in stroke and neurodegeneration.
subtopics.short_description: Microglial signaling, blood-brain barrier dysfunction, and neuroimmune interactions in stroke and neurological disease.

subtopics.label: Headache Disorders and Pain Neuroscience
subtopics.description: Research on headache disorders including migraine, occipital neuralgia, nerve compression headaches, and surgical treatment (nerve decompression). Covers CGRP-targeted therapies, onabotulinumtoxinA, headache surgery outcomes, trigger-site deactivation, and neuropathic pain mechanisms and treatment.
subtopics.short_description: Migraine, neuropathic pain, CGRP-targeted therapies, and surgical nerve decompression for headache disorders.

subtopics.label: Neural Circuits, Cognition, and Memory
subtopics.description: Research on neural circuit mechanisms underlying cognition, memory, learning, and behavior including hippocampal function, prefrontal cortex circuits, synaptic plasticity, and neuromodulation. Covers mnemonic prediction errors, fear learning, social behavior circuits, reward pathways, and the neural basis of cognitive processes.
subtopics.short_description: Circuit mechanisms underlying memory, learning, fear, reward, and social behavior in hippocampal and prefrontal systems.

subtopics.label: Neurodevelopment, Neurogenetics, and Single-Cell Genomics
subtopics.description: Research on brain development, neurogenetics, and single-cell genomic approaches including RNA splicing, isoform analysis, epigenomics, and transcriptomics in brain cell types. Covers neural stem cells, cortical development, interneuron differentiation, and genetic/epigenetic regulation of brain function and disease.
subtopics.short_description: Brain development, neurogenetics, and single-cell transcriptomic and epigenomic regulation of neural cell types.

subtopics.label: Neurovascular Unit and Blood-Brain Barrier
subtopics.description: Research on blood-brain barrier structure and function, neurovascular coupling, glymphatic system, and cerebrovascular biology. Covers BBB permeability measurement, focused ultrasound BBB opening, pericyte biology, endothelial dysfunction, and neurovascular mechanisms in Alzheimer's disease, stroke, and other neurological conditions.
subtopics.short_description: BBB permeability, neurovascular coupling, glymphatic function, and pericyte biology in neurological conditions.

subtopics.label: Movement Disorders and Neuromodulation
subtopics.description: Research on Parkinson's disease, movement disorders, and neuromodulation including deep brain stimulation (DBS), spinal cord stimulation, transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS), and focused ultrasound. Covers DBS programming, patient attitudes toward DBS, motor circuit mechanisms, and wearable technology for movement disorder monitoring.
subtopics.short_description: Deep brain stimulation, TMS, focused ultrasound, and wearable monitoring for Parkinson's and movement disorders.

subtopics.label: Alzheimer's Disease Biomarkers and Neuroimaging
subtopics.description: Research on Alzheimer's disease biomarkers including amyloid-beta, tau PET, CSF markers, glymphatic clearance, and neuroimaging measures of disease progression. Covers tau-amyloid interactions, blood-brain barrier dysfunction in AD, sleep and tau deposition, choroid plexus, and multimodal imaging approaches for early detection and staging.
subtopics.short_description: Amyloid, tau PET, CSF markers, and multimodal imaging for early detection and staging of Alzheimer's disease.

subtopics.label: Spinal Cord Injury and Spine Surgery
subtopics.description: Research on traumatic spinal cord injury, degenerative spine disease, and spine surgery outcomes including cervical myelopathy, lumbar disc disease, and spinal cord tumors. Covers surgical techniques, neurological outcomes, global health perspectives on spinal trauma, and complications of spine surgery.
subtopics.short_description: Traumatic spinal cord injury, degenerative spine disease, surgical outcomes, and global perspectives on spinal trauma.

subtopics.label: Late-Life Depression, Mood Disorders, and Psychiatric Neuroscience
subtopics.description: Research on the neurobiology, neuroimaging correlates, and treatment of late-life depression, bipolar disorder, PTSD, and related mood disorders, including psychotherapy outcomes and brain circuit dysfunction.
subtopics.short_description: Neurobiology, neuroimaging, and treatment of late-life depression, bipolar disorder, PTSD, and related mood disorders.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Neurological Complications and Long COVID
subtopics.description: Studies examining neurological manifestations of COVID-19 infection, including brain imaging findings, cognitive sequelae, long COVID symptoms, post-acute sequelae (PASC), and rehabilitation of neuropsychiatric complications.
subtopics.short_description: Brain imaging findings, cognitive sequelae, and neuropsychiatric rehabilitation in acute and post-acute COVID-19.

subtopics.label: Skull Base Surgery and Cranial Approaches
subtopics.description: Research on surgical approaches to the skull base, cavernous sinus, craniovertebral junction, and parasellar regions, including endoscopic, transpetrosal, frontotemporal, and far lateral techniques.
subtopics.short_description: Endoscopic and open surgical approaches to the skull base, cavernous sinus, and craniovertebral junction.

subtopics.label: Meningioma: PET/MRI Imaging and Treatment
subtopics.description: Studies using DOTATATE PET/MRI for meningioma diagnosis, grading, radiosurgery planning, and response assessment, as well as novel medical therapies for meningiomas.
subtopics.short_description: DOTATATE PET/MRI for meningioma diagnosis, radiosurgery planning, response assessment, and novel medical therapies.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Brain Tumors and CNS Gliomas
subtopics.description: Research on pediatric brain tumors including DIPG, high-grade gliomas, ATRT, and leptomeningeal disease, encompassing convection-enhanced delivery, intraarterial drug delivery, and molecular classification.
subtopics.short_description: DIPG, high-grade gliomas, and pediatric CNS tumors including convection-enhanced and intraarterial drug delivery.

subtopics.label: CNS Gene Therapy and AAV Vector Delivery
subtopics.description: Studies on adeno-associated virus (AAV)-mediated gene therapy for neurological diseases including CLN2 Batten disease, metachromatic leukodystrophy, and SMA, including biodistribution, safety, and efficacy outcomes.
subtopics.display_name: CNS Gene Therapy & AAV Vector Delivery
subtopics.short_description: AAV-mediated gene therapy for Batten disease, leukodystrophy, and SMA, including safety and biodistribution outcomes.

subtopics.label: Delirium in Pediatric and Critical Care Settings
subtopics.description: Research on the prevalence, risk factors, biomarkers, and outcomes of delirium in pediatric ICU, NICU, and hematopoietic cell transplant settings, including pharmacological prevention strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence, biomarkers, risk factors, and pharmacological prevention of delirium in pediatric ICU and NICU settings.

subtopics.label: Stroke Diagnosis, Misdiagnosis, and Quality of Care
subtopics.description: Studies examining diagnostic accuracy, misdiagnosis rates, quality metrics, and healthcare disparities in acute ischemic stroke and TIA management in emergency and inpatient settings.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnostic accuracy, misdiagnosis rates, quality metrics, and healthcare disparities in acute stroke and TIA management.

subtopics.label: Ischemic Stroke Mechanisms, Imaging, and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on the pathophysiology, neuroimaging biomarkers (OEF, QSM, retinal vessels), cardioembolic sources, and clinical outcomes of ischemic stroke and cerebrovascular events.
subtopics.short_description: Pathophysiology, neuroimaging biomarkers, cardioembolic sources, and clinical outcomes of ischemic cerebrovascular events.

subtopics.label: Dysphagia, Voice Disorders, and Swallowing Neuroscience
subtopics.description: Studies on swallowing dysfunction, aspiration, post-swallow residue, respiratory-swallow coordination, and laryngeal motor neuropathy in neurological conditions including Parkinson's disease.
subtopics.short_description: Swallowing dysfunction, aspiration, respiratory-swallow coordination, and laryngeal neuropathy in neurological disease.

subtopics.label: Breast Reconstruction Sensory Reinnervation
subtopics.description: Research on targeted nipple-areola complex reinnervation and sensory recovery following mastectomy and breast reconstruction, including gender-affirming surgery and comparison of reconstructive techniques.
subtopics.short_description: Targeted nipple-areola reinnervation and sensory recovery following mastectomy and gender-affirming reconstruction.

subtopics.label: HIV-Associated Neurocognitive Disorders
subtopics.description: Studies on cognitive impairment, brain abnormalities, biomarkers, and neuropathology in people living with HIV, including CSF compartmentalization, galectin-9, and cellular rejuvenation strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Cognitive impairment, brain biomarkers, CSF compartmentalization, and neuropathology in people living with HIV.

subtopics.label: Neuroimmunology and Innate Lymphoid Cell Biology
subtopics.description: Research on innate lymphoid cells (ILCs), neuropeptide regulation of mucosal immunity, gut-brain immune interactions, and the role of ILC3s in neuroinflammation and tissue protection.
subtopics.short_description: Innate lymphoid cells, neuropeptide-mediated mucosal immunity, and gut-brain immune interactions in neuroinflammation.

subtopics.label: Neurosteroids, Reproductive Hormones, and Mood
subtopics.description: Studies on allopregnanolone, progesterone metabolites, and neuroactive steroids in perinatal anxiety, postpartum depression, and reproductive mood disorders, including estrogen receptor biology.
subtopics.short_description: Allopregnanolone and neuroactive steroids in perinatal anxiety, postpartum depression, and reproductive mood disorders.

subtopics.label: Neurosurgical Education, Simulation, and Assistive Technology
subtopics.description: Research on surgical training methods including augmented reality, virtual reality, 3D neuroanatomy courses, and assistive technology access for patients with brain injury and cognitive impairment.
subtopics.short_description: Augmented reality, virtual reality, and 3D simulation tools for surgical training and patient assistive technology access.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Clinical Outcomes, Severity, and Hospitalization
subtopics.description: Research on clinical characteristics, risk factors, severity predictors, and outcomes of hospitalized COVID-19 patients, including comorbidity effects (diabetes, obesity, cancer, heart failure), viral load correlates, and mortality risk stratification.
subtopics.short_description: Risk factors, comorbidity effects, and mortality stratification in hospitalized COVID-19 patients.

subtopics.label: SARS-CoV-2 Immunology, Antibody Responses, and Vaccine Effectiveness
subtopics.description: Studies on immune responses to SARS-CoV-2 infection and vaccination, including antibody kinetics, neutralizing antibody development, vaccine effectiveness against variants, waning immunity, hybrid immunity, and breakthrough infections.
subtopics.short_description: Antibody kinetics, neutralizing responses, vaccine effectiveness against variants, and waning or hybrid immunity.

subtopics.label: SARS-CoV-2 Variants, Transmission Dynamics, and Epidemiology
subtopics.description: Epidemiological studies on SARS-CoV-2 variant emergence and spread, transmission dynamics, seroprevalence surveys, reinfection rates, and mathematical modeling of COVID-19 epidemic trajectories.
subtopics.short_description: Variant emergence, seroprevalence, reinfection rates, and mathematical modeling of COVID-19 epidemic trajectories.

subtopics.label: HIV Biology, Reservoir, Antiretroviral Therapy, and Immune Responses
subtopics.description: Research on HIV-1 molecular biology, viral reservoirs, latency reversal, antiretroviral therapy effects on immune reconstitution, HIV-specific T cell and antibody responses, and strategies toward HIV cure.
subtopics.short_description: HIV-1 molecular biology, viral latency, antiretroviral immune reconstitution, and cure-directed strategies.

subtopics.label: HIV Clinical Management, Comorbidities, and Aging
subtopics.description: Clinical studies on people living with HIV focusing on comorbidities (cardiovascular disease, renal dysfunction, neurocognitive impairment, metabolic disorders), aging-related complications, and longitudinal health outcomes in HIV-positive populations.
subtopics.short_description: Cardiovascular, renal, neurocognitive, and metabolic complications in people aging with HIV.

subtopics.label: HIV Prevention, Testing, PrEP, and Community Engagement
subtopics.description: Research on HIV prevention strategies including PrEP uptake and adherence, HIV testing programs (including traditional healer-delivered testing), stigma reduction, and community-based interventions to improve HIV care cascade outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: PrEP uptake, HIV testing programs, stigma reduction, and community-based care cascade interventions.

subtopics.label: Hepatitis B, C, and D: Epidemiology, Treatment, and Elimination
subtopics.description: Studies on hepatitis B, C, and D virus epidemiology, treatment access and outcomes, elimination strategies, Medicaid policy impacts on HCV treatment, and HCV/HBV in special populations including pregnant women and people who inject drugs.
subtopics.display_name: Hepatitis B, C & D Elimination Strategies
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology, treatment access, and elimination policy for hepatitis B, C, and D across diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Tuberculosis Biology, Drug Development, and Clinical Management
subtopics.description: Research on Mycobacterium tuberculosis biology, drug targets and novel antimycobacterial compounds, mechanisms of drug resistance, latent TB, and clinical management of tuberculosis including drug-resistant strains.
subtopics.short_description: Mycobacterium tuberculosis drug targets, resistance mechanisms, and clinical management of drug-resistant TB.

subtopics.label: Malaria Parasite Biology, Drug Resistance, and Antimalarial Development
subtopics.description: Studies on Plasmodium falciparum and vivax biology including antigenic variation, epigenetic regulation, drug resistance mechanisms, and development of novel antimalarial compounds targeting the proteasome and other pathways.
subtopics.short_description: Plasmodium biology, drug resistance mechanisms, and novel antimalarial compound discovery.

subtopics.label: Sexually Transmitted Infections: Epidemiology, Prevention, and Vaccines
subtopics.description: Epidemiological studies and mathematical modeling of sexually transmitted infections including HSV-1/2, gonorrhea, chlamydia, syphilis, and HPV, with focus on global burden, transmission dynamics, and vaccine or prevention strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Global burden, transmission dynamics, and vaccine or prevention strategies for HSV, gonorrhea, syphilis, and HPV.

subtopics.label: Antimicrobial Resistance, Stewardship, and Rapid Diagnostics
subtopics.description: Research on antimicrobial resistance mechanisms and epidemiology, rapid molecular diagnostic tests for resistant pathogens, antimicrobial stewardship programs, and clinical outcomes of infections caused by drug-resistant organisms.
subtopics.short_description: Resistance mechanisms, rapid molecular diagnostics, stewardship programs, and outcomes of drug-resistant infections.

subtopics.label: SARS-CoV-2 Pathophysiology, Molecular Biology, and Experimental Models
subtopics.description: Mechanistic studies on SARS-CoV-2 infection biology including viral entry, host cell tropism, organoid and stem cell models, pathological findings (autopsy, histology), and molecular mechanisms of COVID-19 organ damage.
subtopics.short_description: Viral entry, host cell tropism, organoid models, and molecular mechanisms of COVID-19 organ damage.

subtopics.label: Long COVID and Post-Acute Sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 Infection
subtopics.description: Research on post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 infection (PASC/Long COVID) including prevalence, risk factors, subphenotypes, neurological and cognitive manifestations, and potential treatments.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence, risk factors, neurological manifestations, and emerging treatments for post-acute SARS-CoV-2 sequelae.

subtopics.label: Fungal Infections, Gut Mycobiome, and Host-Fungal Interactions
subtopics.description: Studies on fungal pathogens and the gut mycobiome, including Candida and other fungi in health and disease, fungal regulation of mucosal immunity, mycobiota-IgA interactions, and fungal involvement in inflammatory bowel disease and cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Fungal pathogens, mycobiota-immune interactions, and fungal roles in inflammatory bowel disease and cancer.

subtopics.label: Cytomegalovirus Infection, Immunity, and Vaccine Development
subtopics.description: Research on human and rhesus cytomegalovirus biology, immune correlates of protection, congenital CMV transmission, and development and evaluation of CMV vaccine candidates including mRNA and subunit approaches.
subtopics.short_description: CMV biology, immune correlates of protection, congenital transmission, and mRNA or subunit vaccine candidates.
